title: Inter's keeper is picked — Chivu just won't say it
caption:
Inter's goalkeeper for the derby is picked — Chivu just won't say who. Gazzetta dello Sport and Corriere dello Sport both expect Josep Martínez to start, per FCInterNews; Inter have published no lineup. Milan v Inter, San Siro, 3:45 PM ET.
